callers.reachability: reached only by code, never by data
callers.stored_references: none: 0 RELATIVE relocations for 0x5d55870, 0 stored qwords

observations: The routine writes nothing back to the object: no field is cleared and no size is reset.
An empty but non-null buffer (end == begin) still reaches the sized delete, with size 0.
The three buffers are freed in the fixed order A, B, C regardless of their addresses or sizes.
The +0x48 release is a tail jump, so the helper's return is the routine's return; the three buffer frees are direct calls.

The release helper 0x5d350c0 is pinned by call shape only here; its internal release contract (64-bit count at +0x08, destroy at zero) is established in the RE-001 derived-destructor packet for the same helper address.
